intake_facts: FY2025: revenue $63.887B, operating income $25.484B, net income $23.126B, OCF $27.537B, capex $0.623B, SBC $7.568B.
Q3 FY2026: revenue $29.591B (+86% y/y), operating income $15.955B, net income $13.088B and diluted weighted-average shares 4.887B.
9M FY2026: revenue $71.089B, OCF $32.950B, capex $1.013B and SBC $6.287B.
2026-08-02 cash $23.975B, short-term debt $2.252B and long-term debt $57.167B; net debt is $35.444B before other financing adjustments.
TTM to 2026-08-02 estimate from FY2025 plus 9M FY2026 less 9M FY2025: revenue $89.104B, OCF $40.653B, capex $1.250B, SBC $8.482B.
TTM owner-FCF proxy (OCF-capex-SBC) is $30.921B, or about $6.33 per Q3 diluted share. This is a downstream estimate, not an FP fact.
Q3 FY2026 segment revenue: Semiconductor Solutions $20.839B; Infrastructure Software $8.752B. 9M figures were $48.363B and $22.726B.
9M FY2026 geographic shipment revenue: Americas $15.796B, Asia Pacific $47.094B, EMEA $8.199B; geography is based primarily on shipment/delivery location.
Top five end customers represented approximately 55% of Q3 FY2026 revenue and 50% of 9M revenue; individual customer shares were not disclosed.
Approximately 95% of contract-manufactured wafers were produced by TSMC during 9M FY2026.
Remaining performance obligations at 2026-08-02 were approximately $179.2B and include a long-term custom AI accelerator contract.
Official Q4 FY2026 revenue guidance is approximately $34.8B (+93% y/y), implying full-year revenue around $105.9B if achieved.
EV Base revenue path is a scenario assumption rather than a frozen external forecast; the 3-year CAGR signal is 43.81% and is stress-tested through Bear/Base/Bull owner-FCF paths.
valuation_metric: No 5-year percentile locked; valuation is driven by frozen-price owner-FCF/share DCF.
